title: Spellforge Insectarium
description: A gothic woman with magenta hair and a black dress stands beside a wooden cabinet labeled 'Spellforge Insectarium - Garden of Chains' displaying pinned insects, a crystal ball, and Halloween masks. A glowing turquoise fairy-like alien with purple butterfly wings floats above her in a swirling purple sky over a fantasy landscape with a castle, a hiker, and a dragon.
prompt: A gothic woman with long magenta hair wearing a flowing black dress stands in the foreground next to a tall wooden display cabinet labeled Spellforge Insectarium - Garden of Chains, which contains pinned moths, spiders, a glowing crystal ball on a stand, and Halloween masks.
